title: AIWF Loop Approval Policy
description: How the multi-agent loop treats approval gates. Stored at .agents/config/loop-approval.json. git/release/deploy are NEVER auto-approved.

mode.description: auto = record a real approval and continue; manual = HALT for a human.

auto_gates.description: Gates auto mode may approve. git/release/deploy are excluded by policy regardless.

never_auto_gates.description: Always-manual gates; unioned with the hard defaults git/release/deploy.

gate_commands.description: Per-gate canonical CLI command (argv array) that records the approval. ${workflow}/${gate} are substituted. Missing command => that gate falls back to manual.
